title: progenitor.json
description: Optional Progenitor details at the root of a mod package. Kept apart from manifest.json so the same zip still uploads to Thunderstore unchanged. Fields not listed here are allowed and ignored, so new ones can be added later.

sides.description: Where the mod runs. When missing, Progenitor works it out from the package.

side.description: Same as sides; the spelling Progenitor's publish-check writes. sides wins when both are present.

progenitor.description: The Progenitor version range the mod needs, for example ">=2026.10.162". When missing, it comes from a Progenitor entry in the manifest dependencies, otherwise any version.
